read_only_refresh: source-pinned snapshot of the unchanged local software body; zero native cycles; no training and no counterfactual forecast
outcome: requested walk is admitted and physical model remains valid; this is not route completion
labels: same-model shadow walk from each initial checkpoint, generated only after every arm's final decision is durably saved; unavailable to controller
metrics: vetoed or invalid attempted requests per case
acceptance: disjoint train and held-out initial checkpoint hashes
at most one read-only refresh and one native request per trial
cold process resumes a saved decision identically
persisted outcome reconciles without a native cycle
all cases and tradeoffs reported even if no improvement
scope: authored deterministic body-admission challenge, inspired by MIRROR's knowing-doing comparison; not a MIRROR replication, language-model evaluation, physical-body validation or consciousness score
stale_fixture_construction: snapshot, then six-second native observe prelude on a synthetic fixture; this prelude is common to all arms and excluded from incremental policy costs
